displayName: Vinted API - Listings, Prices, Sellers Across 27 Markets
description: Vinted API as structured JSON - search second-hand listings on any of 27 Vinted country sites (France, UK, US, Germany, Poland, Spain, Italy, the Netherlands, Australia and more) by keyword, category, brand, condition, size, color, material and price range, 96 items per page with price, the Vinted fee and the total, read one listing in full, pull a seller's public profile, listed items and reviews, and look up brand ids, filter options with live counts, the category tree and search autocomplete. 9 endpoints, 1 credit each.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
